Name: King Nebuchadnezzar
Summary: Nebuchadnezzar was Babylon's mighty king who conquered Jerusalem and carried Judah into exile, yet through Daniel God humbled and taught him. He ended by praising the King of Heaven in a public decree.
KeyStory: After seven years living like an animal for his pride, Nebuchadnezzar raised his eyes to heaven, his sanity was restored, and he blessed the Most High.
KeyVerses: Daniel 4:34-37; Daniel 1:1-2; Jeremiah 25:9; 2 Kings 24:1; 2 Kings 25:1; Jeremiah 27:6-8; Jeremiah 39:1-7; Daniel 2:1; Daniel 4:28-37; Ezra 2:1; Nehemiah 7:6
RelatedBooks: Daniel; Jeremiah; 2 Kings; Ezekiel; 2 Chronicles; Ezra; Nehemiah
RelatedPeople: Daniel; Ezekiel; Jehoiakim, King of Judah; Jehoiachin, King of Judah; Zedekiah, King of Judah; Nebuzaradan, Captain of the Guard; Gedaliah, Son of Ahikam; Jeremiah; Belshazzar; Shadrach; Meshach; Abednego
LifeLesson: If God could reach the proudest king on earth, He can reach anyone you are praying for. No heart is too hard and no throne too high for heaven to humble and heal.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile; Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace; Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile
